title: Gardiiɗo Ɓuuɓri ndi Muumtataa
intro: Limre ina darii e damal nokku ɓurɗo hulɓinaade e nder ko yiyaaka, halfinaa golle ɗe hay tagoore woɗnde yiɗaa. So ruuhuuji torraaɗi ina ngulla ngam yurmeende, jaabawol tiiɗngol ina ɓuuɓtoo e nder cuuɗi yiite. Mbele aɗa waawi udditaade sifaa oo gardiiɗo duumotooɗo?
clues: Miɗo darii e damal nokku kulɓiniiɗo jukkungo e nder ko yi’ataake.
Yiite ɓuuɓnge, nde ɓuuɓnataa, ko kañum woni cakkital golle am tedduɗe.
Yontaaji torrooji ina nodda innde am, ina ñaagoo ballal e torlaaji mum en ɗi ngalaa ɗo kaaɗi.
So ɓe ñaagiima, miɗo anndi ɓe njaltataa, haa abada.
Mi wonaa neɗɗo, mi wonaa jinne — ko mi tagaaɗo ɗooftaare laaɓnde.
Ko miin woni mawɗo maleyka toɗɗaaɗo ngam wonde gardiiɗo jeynge haa abada.

arabic: وَنَادَوْا۟ يَـٰمَـٰلِكُ لِيَقْضِ عَلَيْنَا رَبُّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّكُم مَّـٰكِثُونَ
verse: And they will call, "O Mālik, let your Lord put an end to us!" He will say, "Indeed, you will remain." (43:77)
